summary.zh: 改进提示词并评测模型输出质量
summary.en: Improve prompts and measure model quality

description.zh: 能修整前后不一致的提示词，搭建评测集，给 RAG 召回结果打分，并检查 agent 的工具配置。适合聊天机器人或 RAG 回答忽好忽坏、需要先量化再改的时候使用。
description.en: Fixes inconsistent prompts, builds eval sets, scores RAG retrieval and checks agent tool configuration. Use it when a chatbot or RAG answer is unreliable and you want a measurable baseline before changing anything.
